Property and casualty insurance is underwritten by Porch Risk Management Services, LLC, its attorney-in-fact. 1. Use of the term "member" or "membership" refers to membership in Porch Insurance Reciprocal Exchange (Porch Insurance) and does not convey any legal or ownership rights in Porch Insurance. Restrictions apply and are subject to change. 2. Discount is only available for new home purchases, applies in years 1-3 in diminishing amounts, and ceases at year 4. Discount does not apply to premium for theft or liability coverages or any mandatory fees. Restrictions apply. See policy documents for full details. 3. All coverages are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable policy documents for details. 4. Individual coverage limits apply. $200 service call fee applies when the warranty claim is dispatched. 5. Membership rewards and perks include services that may be included in and/or benefits covered under the policy and may be provided by companies who have no affiliation with Porch Insurance and have sole financial responsibility for their products and services. 6. Terms and conditions: Subject to availability. Offer includes 2 movers for 2 hours scheduled in advance. Only available on new policies. Policy must be verified as bound or active within 60 days of its effective date. Must use within 90 days of policy issue date. Only one move per policy. You may add additional hours or movers, or book a same-day move, at your own cost. There is no cash alternative. Porch is not responsible for any additional costs and/or expenses in relation to the Offer. Non-transferable. Subject to HireAHelper terms at https://www.porchmovinggroup.com/legal/general-terms/. 7. Inspection report must be provided and reflect an inspection on the subject property within 3 years of the policy effective date by a licensed inspector. To maintain discount, inspection report must be provided every 3 years. Discount does not apply to premium for fire peril. Restrictions apply. See policy documents for full details. 8. With your first year of membership, you'll get four $25 coupons to use toward Porch handyman services. Limit one coupon per appointment. Coupons may not be combined with any other offers or discounts for the same service. Coupons cannot be applied to sales tax or prior purchases, and are not reusable. Any unused portion of a credit may not be carried over. Coupons have no cash value, are not redeemable for cash, and are non-transferable. Coupons are void if altered, copied, transferred, auctioned or sold. Porch services may not be available in all areas. 9. Savings figures are based on the average of all included offers during the current calendar year and may vary by location. By clicking on a vendor product or service, Porch Insurance may share your personal information with the company or others for authentication purposes and to facilitate your effort to transact business with their company. These companies are solely responsible for the protection of your data and the financial responsibility for their products and services.
